name: PG&E CARE & FERA
description: 35% or more off electricity bills and 20% or more off natural gas through CARE (18% off electricity through FERA); enrollment also qualifies for more incentives from other programs
fullDescription: PG&E's CARE (California Alternate Rates for Energy) and FERA (Family Electric Rate Assistance) programs provide significant utility bill discounts for income-qualified households.
whatTheyOffer:
- CARE: 35% or more off electricity, 20% or more off natural gas
- FERA: 18% discount on electricity for larger households
- Gateway to many other programs and rebates
- Can be combined with Medical Baseline if medically necessary
- Recertify every 2 years (every 4 years on fixed income); PG&E mails a renewal notice
howToGetIt:
1. Check income eligibility (guidelines change each June; current limits valid through May 31, 2027)
2. CARE: Income at or below 200% federal poverty level
3. FERA: 3+ person household, slightly higher income limits
4. Apply online at pge.com/care (English, Spanish, Chinese)
5. Or mail or email (CAREandFERA@pge.com) a printed application
6. No documents needed to apply; provide income verification if requested
keywords: CARE, FERA, PG&E, utility discount, electricity, gas, low-income, bill assistance, 35% discount, energy bill
